tasks.name: Fix FizzBuzz
tasks.description: Classic FizzBuzz has a branch-ordering bug: multiples of 15 never print FizzBuzz.
tasks.prompt: The file fizzbuzz.js contains a buggy fizzbuzz implementation. The test file fizzbuzz.test.mjs describes the expected behavior. Fix fizzbuzz.js so all tests pass. Do not modify the test file.

tasks.name: Fix dropRight off-by-one
tasks.description: dropRight removes one element too many; edge cases around empty results fail.
tasks.prompt: The file dropRight.js implements dropRight with an off-by-one bug. The test file dropRight.test.mjs describes the expected behavior. Fix dropRight.js so all tests pass. Do not modify the test file.

tasks.name: Implement debounce
tasks.description: Implement a clock-injectable debounce with cancel(), probed at call boundaries.
tasks.prompt: Implement the debounce function in debounce.js according to its doc comment. The test file debounce.test.mjs describes the exact semantics (including the injectable clock and lazy boundary flushing). Make all tests pass. Do not modify the test file.

tasks.name: Implement mapLimit
tasks.description: Async map with bounded concurrency, ordered results, rejection propagation.
tasks.prompt: Implement the mapLimit function in mapLimit.js according to its doc comment. The test file mapLimit.test.mjs verifies ordering, the concurrency bound and error propagation. Make all tests pass. Do not modify the test file.

tasks.name: Fix CSV parsing
tasks.description: Naive comma split breaks on quoted fields and escaped quotes.
tasks.prompt: The file csv.js contains a naive CSV line parser that breaks on quoted fields. The test file csv.test.mjs describes the expected behavior (quoted fields may contain commas; a doubled double-quote inside a quoted field is an escaped quote). Fix csv.js so all tests pass. Do not modify the test file.

tasks.name: Implement O(1) LRU Cache
tasks.description: Classic data-structure interview task — agents frequently botch edge cases
tasks.prompt: Implement the LRUCache class in lru.js: constructor(capacity), get(key) returns value or -1 and marks key most-recently-used, put(key,value) inserts/updates and evicts the least-recently-used key when capacity is exceeded. All operations must be O(1) amortized. The test file lru.test.mjs describes the expected behavior.

tasks.name: Fix async counter race
tasks.description: Concurrency bug — lost updates from unawaited promises
tasks.prompt: counter.js exports async function incrementN(store, n) which should increment store.value exactly n times concurrently-safe and resolve only after ALL increments settle. It currently loses updates. Fix it WITHOUT serializing the operations with a sleep — the tests check both correctness and that the implementation does not simply run increments sequentially (they must overlap). The test file counter.test.mjs describes expected behavior.

tasks.name: CSV column type inference
tasks.description: Parsing + inference task with quoted fields and empty-vs-null semantics
tasks.prompt: Implement inferColumnTypes(csvText) in csvtypes.js: parse a CSV document where fields may be quoted with double quotes (embedded commas, escaped quotes as ""), then for each column infer 'integer' if every non-empty cell parses as an integer, 'float' if every non-empty cell parses as a float (a column may be float even when some cells are integers), 'empty' if all cells are empty strings, else 'string'. Cells that are empty strings NEVER affect integer/float inference (they are skipped). Return an array of type strings, one per column. The test file csvtypes.test.mjs describes the expected behavior.
